paper_title: A quantum-enhanced search for dark matter axions
coupling_convention: g_agamma in GeV^-1, converted from g_gamma = 1.38 x g_gamma^KSVZ using g_agamma = (alpha/2pi)(g_gamma/f_a) and m_a-f_a relation
notes: HAYSTAC quantum-enhanced (squeezed state receiver) axion haloscope. Exclusion at g_gamma = 1.38 x KSVZ over 16.96-17.12 and 17.14-17.28 ueV/c^2 (4.100-4.140 and 4.145-4.178 GHz), 90% CL. Paper reports coupling as multiple of g_gamma^KSVZ; I converted to g_agamma in GeV^-1 using standard KSVZ scaling (g_agamma^KSVZ ~3.4e-15 GeV^-1 near 17 ueV). Values are approximate due to conversion.
